description: This file defines the ProfileReader class, which implements logic to read user profile information, including checks for relationships like followers, from a database context using Entity Framework. It transforms domain data into a profile envelope suitable for API responses.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class that reads user profile data from the database and constructs profile response objects, handling follower relationship logic and error cases.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile by username, checks for current user's follow status, and returns the profile envelope or throws exceptions if user not found.
